messages:
maria_g: Hey support — customer (acme-inc) reports high latency and billing spikes. They say requests are landing in us-west instead of eu-west.

kevin_s: Can you paste a raw request/headers? any correlation id?

maria_g: here's a captured request header (sanitized):

X-Client-Region: eu-west|us-west
X-Request-ID: req_86a2b3c
Host: api.redwood.example

sophie: That '|' is suspicious. our router expects comma-separated or single value. If proxy concatenated multiple headers with '|' we might treat it as unknown -> fallback to nearest POP.

kevin_s: repro steps?

maria_g: steps: 1) client sends two X-Client-Region headers (eu-west and us-west) via legacy proxy that merges into single header using '|' 2) send POST /v1/generate with token 3) observe routing to us-west and ~120ms extra RTT 4) check billing tags -> shows us-west

sophie: logs: "router: selected_pop=us-west; region_token='eu-west|us-west' ; parse_result=unknown" — attaching excerpt.

eng-oncall-bot: Incident #INC-2026-447 created: misroute-eu->us due to header format. Pager duty notified.

alejandro_r: quick mitigation: add header normalization to edge proxy to split on common separators (comma, semicolon, '|', whitespace) and pick the FIRST non-empty token. Hotfix deployed to canary edge.

kevin_s: sample nginx config snippet we used in canary:

location / {
  proxy_set_header X-Client-Region $http_x_client_region;
  # normalize in lua
  access_by_lua_block {
    local hdr = ngx.var.http_x_client_region or \"\"
    hdr = hdr:gsub(\"[|;]\",\",")
    local first = hdr:match(\"^%s*([^,]+)\") or \"\"
    ngx.req.set_header(\\\"X-Client-Region\\\", first)
  }
}

sophie: Followup asks to support team: does customer control the proxy? yes — they use vendor ELB that recently patched upstream and changed header merge behavior.

maria_g: customer will patch but wants us to add tolerant parsing server-side and a retro billing correction if necessary.

alejandro_r: ops: we should patch router parsing library to tolerate multiple separators and prefer explicit list param over header if both present. I'll open a PR and schedule canary rollout.

kevin_s: also want to add an eval to detect '|' in header to generate telemetry alert.

maria_g: customer impact: about 0.7% of requests from their org in last 24h. they asked for credits if routing caused higher egress.

eng-oncall-bot: Update: canary hotfix deployed to eu-west-canary at 2026-03-15T14:12:00Z

sophie: monitoring shows routing normalized for new requests. need to run backfill to detect past misrouted requests and tag for billing review.

maria_g: filed billing ticket with finance ticket FIN-2026-89. keeping customer updated.

kevin_s: thanks everyone, will follow up with PR link and postmortem draft.
